_meta.salary_note: Salary figures are illustrative US annual ranges in the style of BLS Occupational Outlook Handbook data (low = ~10th percentile, median = ~50th, high = ~90th). Replace with a live BLS export for production use.
_meta.outlook_note: Projected employment change, 2022-2032 style figures. Illustrative.

careers.title: Registered Nurse
careers.education_note: ADN or BSN, then pass the NCLEX-RN licensing exam
careers.description: Cares for patients in hospitals and clinics, gives treatments and medications, and is the person families talk to most.

careers.title: Physician (MD/DO)
careers.education_note: Bachelor's + 4-year medical school + 3-7 year residency
careers.description: Diagnoses and treats illness, leads a care team, and carries final responsibility for patient decisions.

careers.title: Physical Therapist
careers.education_note: Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT) + state license
careers.description: Helps people recover movement after injury or surgery through hands-on treatment and exercise plans.

careers.title: Dental Hygienist
careers.education_note: 2-year accredited hygiene program + state license
careers.description: Cleans teeth, screens for oral disease, and coaches patients on care -- often on a flexible 3-4 day schedule.

careers.title: Radiologic Technologist
careers.education_note: Associate degree in radiography + ARRT certification
careers.description: Runs X-ray, CT and MRI equipment and positions patients so doctors get usable images.

careers.title: Pharmacist
careers.education_note: Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD) + state license
careers.description: Dispenses medication, checks for dangerous drug interactions, and advises patients and physicians on dosing.

careers.title: Paramedic / EMT
careers.education_note: EMT certificate (~6 months) or paramedic program (1-2 years)
careers.description: First on scene in an emergency -- stabilizes patients and makes fast calls on the way to the hospital.

careers.title: Medical Laboratory Technician
careers.education_note: Associate degree in clinical lab science + certification
careers.description: Runs the blood and tissue tests behind most diagnoses, working with lab instruments rather than patients.

careers.title: Mental Health Counselor
careers.education_note: Master's in counseling + supervised clinical hours + license
careers.description: Works one-on-one with clients on anxiety, depression, addiction and life transitions.

careers.title: Veterinarian
careers.education_note: Bachelor's + 4-year Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM)
careers.description: Diagnoses and treats animals, performs surgery, and counsels owners through hard decisions.

careers.title: Veterinary Technician
careers.education_note: 2-year vet tech program + credentialing exam
careers.description: The nurse of the animal clinic -- runs labs, assists in surgery, and monitors recovering patients.

careers.title: Occupational Therapist
careers.education_note: Master's in occupational therapy + national exam + license
careers.description: Helps people relearn daily tasks after injury or illness by adapting tools, homes and routines.

careers.title: Speech-Language Pathologist
careers.education_note: Master's in speech-language pathology + clinical fellowship + license
careers.description: Treats speech, language and swallowing disorders in kids and adults, often inside schools or hospitals.

careers.title: Registered Dietitian
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in nutrition + supervised internship + RD exam
careers.description: Builds nutrition plans for patients managing diabetes, heart disease, allergies or athletic goals.

careers.title: Dental Assistant
careers.education_note: 9-12 month program; some states require an exam
careers.description: Works chairside with the dentist -- preps patients, takes X-rays, and keeps the procedure moving.

careers.title: Software Engineer
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in computer science, or a bootcamp/self-taught portfolio
careers.description: Designs and writes the code behind apps, websites and internal systems, then keeps it running.

careers.title: Data Scientist
careers.education_note: Bachelor's minimum; master's in stats/CS is common
careers.description: Finds patterns in large datasets and builds models that businesses use to make decisions.

careers.title: Cybersecurity Analyst
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in CS/IT, or certifications (Security+, CISSP)
careers.description: Defends networks from attackers, investigates breaches, and hardens systems before they are hit.

careers.title: IT Support Specialist
careers.education_note: CompTIA A+ certificate or associate degree
careers.description: The person who gets everyone else working again -- fixes hardware, accounts, networks and software.

careers.title: Cloud / DevOps Engineer
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in CS/IT + cloud certifications (AWS, Azure)
careers.description: Builds the deployment pipelines and cloud infrastructure that software runs on.

careers.title: UX Designer
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in design/HCI, or a strong portfolio
careers.description: Researches how people use a product, then designs screens and flows that feel obvious.

careers.title: Game Developer
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in CS or game design + shipped projects
careers.description: Builds the systems, physics and gameplay behind video games, usually on a tight release schedule.

careers.title: Network Administrator
careers.education_note: Associate or bachelor's in IT + CCNA-type certifications
careers.description: Keeps an organization's networks and servers online, secure and fast.

careers.title: AI / Machine Learning Engineer
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in CS/math; master's common for research roles
careers.description: Trains and ships machine learning models -- recommendation systems, vision, language tools.

careers.title: Mechanical Engineer
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in mechanical engineering; PE license for some roles
careers.description: Designs and tests physical products and machines, from engines to medical devices.

careers.title: Civil Engineer
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in civil engineering + PE license for senior roles
careers.description: Designs roads, bridges, water systems and buildings, then oversees them being built.

careers.title: Electrical Engineer
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in electrical engineering
careers.description: Designs circuits, power systems and electronics for everything from phones to power grids.

careers.title: Aerospace Engineer
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in aerospace or mechanical engineering
careers.description: Designs aircraft, spacecraft and propulsion systems, and tests them to failure on purpose.

careers.title: Biomedical Engineer
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in biomedical engineering
careers.description: Designs prosthetics, imaging machines and implants where engineering meets medicine.

careers.title: Construction Manager
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in construction management, or promotion from the trades
careers.description: Runs the build -- schedules crews and materials, keeps a project on budget and on time.

careers.title: Electrician
careers.education_note: 4-5 year PAID apprenticeship, then journeyman license
careers.description: Installs and repairs the wiring in homes, factories and job sites -- and gets paid while training.

careers.title: Plumber
careers.education_note: 4-5 year paid apprenticeship + state license
careers.description: Installs and repairs water, gas and drainage systems -- a trade that cannot be outsourced.

careers.title: HVAC Technician
careers.education_note: 6-24 month trade program + EPA 608 certification
careers.description: Installs and fixes heating and cooling systems, diagnosing problems in the field.

careers.title: Welder
careers.education_note: Trade school certificate (6-18 months) + AWS certification
careers.description: Joins metal for pipelines, ships, buildings and art -- specialty welders earn far above the median.

careers.title: Automotive Technician
careers.education_note: Trade program (1-2 years) + ASE certification
careers.description: Diagnoses and repairs vehicles -- increasingly a computer job as much as a wrench job.

careers.title: Aircraft Mechanic (A&P)
careers.education_note: FAA-approved A&P program (18-24 months) + certification
careers.description: Inspects and repairs aircraft to FAA standards, where the paperwork matters as much as the wrench.

careers.title: Wind Turbine Technician
careers.education_note: 1-2 year technical certificate + climbing/safety training
careers.description: Climbs and services wind turbines -- one of the fastest-growing jobs in the country.

careers.title: Commercial Truck Driver
careers.education_note: CDL training program (3-8 weeks) + license
careers.description: Moves freight across the country on your own schedule inside the cab, with fast entry into the field.

careers.title: Airline Pilot
careers.education_note: Bachelor's + flight training + 1,500 flight hours for ATP certificate
careers.description: Flies commercial aircraft on a strict schedule, with heavy training and heavy pay.

careers.title: Accountant / CPA
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in accounting; CPA requires 150 credit hours + exam
careers.description: Prepares and audits financial records -- steady demand in every industry that exists.

careers.title: Financial Analyst
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in finance or economics; CFA for advancement
careers.description: Evaluates investments and company performance, and builds the models behind big money decisions.

careers.title: Marketing Manager
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in marketing/communications + several years experience
careers.description: Decides how a product is positioned and sold, and runs the team and budget that make it happen.

careers.title: Human Resources Specialist
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in HR, business or psychology
careers.description: Hires, onboards and supports employees, and handles the conflicts nobody else wants to.

careers.title: Supply Chain Analyst
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in supply chain, business or industrial engineering
careers.description: Figures out how products get from factory to customer for the least money and delay.

careers.title: Small Business Owner
careers.education_note: No formal requirement -- needs a skill, a plan and starting capital
careers.description: Runs your own shop, service or trade company. Highest ceiling and the highest risk on this list.

careers.title: Real Estate Agent
careers.education_note: State licensing course (2-6 months) + exam
careers.description: Helps people buy and sell homes on commission -- income swings with effort and the market.

careers.title: B2B Sales Representative
careers.education_note: Bachelor's typical; strong performers get hired without one
careers.description: Sells products to other companies, with pay tied directly to results.

careers.title: Hotel Manager
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in hospitality management, or promotion from within
careers.description: Runs a property and its staff, fixing guest problems in real time.

careers.title: Chef
careers.education_note: Culinary program (1-2 years) or kitchen apprenticeship
careers.description: Designs menus and runs a kitchen line under real time pressure every single service.

careers.title: Cosmetologist
careers.education_note: State cosmetology program (~1 year) + license
careers.description: Cuts and styles hair and does skin and nail work -- many build a personal client book or own a salon.

careers.title: Elementary School Teacher
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in education + state teaching license
careers.description: Teaches every subject to one class of young kids and shapes how they feel about school.

careers.title: High School Math Teacher
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in math or education + state teaching license
careers.description: Teaches algebra through calculus to teenagers -- a shortage subject in most districts.

careers.title: School Counselor
careers.education_note: Master's in school counseling + state certification
careers.description: Helps students with course plans, college applications and the problems behind their grades.

careers.title: Social Worker
careers.education_note: BSW for entry roles; MSW required for clinical practice
careers.description: Connects families in crisis to housing, healthcare and protective services.

careers.title: Librarian
careers.education_note: Master of Library and Information Science (MLIS)
careers.description: Curates collections, runs programs, and teaches people how to find and judge information.

careers.title: Graphic Designer
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in graphic design, or a strong portfolio
careers.description: Designs logos, packaging, layouts and brand systems for clients or an in-house team.

careers.title: Video Editor / Filmmaker
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in film/media, or a portfolio plus software skill
careers.description: Cuts raw footage into a story for film, TV, ads or social media.

careers.title: Architect
careers.education_note: 5-year B.Arch or M.Arch + internship + ARE licensing exams
careers.description: Designs buildings that are beautiful, legal, structurally sound and on budget -- all at once.

careers.title: Journalist / Reporter
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in journalism or English + published clips
careers.description: Investigates and writes stories on deadline, holding institutions to account.

careers.title: Music Producer
careers.education_note: No formal requirement -- audio program or self-taught + portfolio
careers.description: Records, arranges and mixes music for artists, usually building a client base from scratch.

careers.title: Interior Designer
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in interior design; NCIDQ certification in many states
careers.description: Plans interior spaces -- layout, lighting, materials -- to be livable and code-compliant.

careers.title: Animator / 3D Artist
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in animation, or a demo reel that speaks for itself
careers.description: Creates characters, motion and visual effects for games, film and advertising.

careers.title: Photographer
careers.education_note: No degree required -- portfolio, gear and client base matter most
careers.description: Shoots weddings, products, sports or journalism, usually running your own small business.

careers.title: Police Officer
careers.education_note: High school diploma + police academy (about 6 months)
careers.description: Patrols a community, responds to calls, and investigates crimes -- with a pension and real risk.

careers.title: Firefighter
careers.education_note: Fire academy + EMT certification
careers.description: Fights fires and answers medical calls, living and training with a crew on long shifts.

careers.title: Lawyer
careers.education_note: Bachelor's + 3-year JD + state bar exam
careers.description: Advises and represents clients, writes the arguments, and does far more reading than arguing.

careers.title: Paralegal
careers.education_note: Associate degree or paralegal certificate
careers.description: Does the research, drafting and case organization that keeps attorneys in court.

careers.title: Air Traffic Controller
careers.education_note: FAA Academy program; hiring age cutoff is 31
careers.description: Sequences aircraft in the air and on the ground -- extreme pay for extreme concentration.

careers.title: Urban Planner
careers.education_note: Master's in urban or regional planning
careers.description: Plans how land gets used -- housing, transit, zoning -- and defends it in public meetings.

careers.title: Environmental Scientist
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in environmental science or geology
careers.description: Samples air, soil and water, then writes the reports that drive cleanup and policy.

careers.title: Marine Biologist
careers.education_note: Bachelor's minimum; master's or PhD for research roles
careers.description: Studies ocean life and ecosystems, splitting time between fieldwork and data analysis.

careers.title: Chemist
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in chemistry; PhD for research leadership
careers.description: Develops and tests materials, drugs and formulations in a lab setting.

careers.title: Meteorologist
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in atmospheric science or meteorology
careers.description: Forecasts weather using models and data, for broadcast, aviation, agriculture or the military.

careers.title: Farm / Ranch Manager
careers.education_note: No degree required; an ag degree or family experience is common
careers.description: Runs a working farm or ranch -- crops, livestock, equipment, payroll and weather risk.

careers.title: Personal Trainer
careers.education_note: NASM or ACE certification (3-6 months)
careers.description: Coaches clients through training programs, often building an independent client base.

careers.title: Athletic Trainer
careers.education_note: Master's in athletic training + BOC certification
careers.description: Prevents and treats athletic injuries on the sideline for schools, colleges and pro teams.

careers.title: Nurse Practitioner
careers.education_note: BSN, RN experience, then an MSN/DNP and national certification
careers.description: Diagnoses and treats patients much like a physician, often as a clinic's primary provider.

careers.title: Surgical Technologist
careers.education_note: Accredited surgical tech program, then CST certification
careers.description: Preps the operating room and hands instruments to the surgeon during procedures.

careers.title: Respiratory Therapist
careers.education_note: Associate degree plus the RRT credential
careers.description: Treats patients who can't breathe well, from premature babies to asthma and COVID cases.

careers.title: Diagnostic Medical Sonographer
careers.education_note: Associate degree in sonography plus ARDMS certification
careers.description: Runs ultrasound scans and is often first to see what's actually going on inside a patient.

careers.title: Optometrist
careers.education_note: Four-year Doctor of Optometry after a bachelor's
careers.description: Examines eyes, prescribes glasses and contacts, and catches disease early.

careers.title: Physician Assistant
careers.education_note: Master's from an accredited PA program plus PANCE
careers.description: Examines, diagnoses and treats patients on a physician-led team.

careers.title: Home Health Aide
careers.education_note: Short state-approved training, often paid
careers.description: Helps older and disabled clients with daily life so they can stay in their own homes.

careers.title: Medical Assistant
careers.education_note: Certificate program, usually under a year
careers.description: Takes vitals, draws blood and keeps a clinic's day running.

careers.title: Phlebotomist
careers.education_note: Short certificate plus national certification
careers.description: Draws blood for tests and donations, calmly, all day.

careers.title: Psychologist
careers.education_note: PhD or PsyD plus supervised hours and licensure
careers.description: Assesses and treats mental health conditions through therapy and testing.

careers.title: Web Developer
careers.education_note: Associate degree, bootcamp or a strong portfolio
careers.description: Builds the websites and web apps people use every day.

careers.title: Mobile App Developer
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in CS or an equivalent portfolio
careers.description: Builds the iPhone and Android apps in everyone's pocket.

careers.title: Database Administrator
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in CS or IS, plus vendor certifications
careers.description: Keeps an organisation's data fast, backed up and secure.

careers.title: QA / Test Engineer
careers.education_note: Bachelor's, or a certificate plus demonstrated skill
careers.description: Breaks software on purpose so customers never have to.

careers.title: Technical Writer
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in English, communications or a technical field
careers.description: Turns complicated systems into documentation people can follow.

careers.title: GIS Analyst
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in geography, GIS or environmental science
careers.description: Maps and analyses spatial data for cities, utilities and conservation groups.

careers.title: Robotics Technician
careers.education_note: Associate degree in robotics or mechatronics
careers.description: Installs, programs and repairs the robots on factory floors.

careers.title: Industrial Engineer
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in industrial or systems engineering
careers.description: Redesigns how work flows so factories and hospitals waste less time.

careers.title: Chemical Engineer
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in chemical engineering
careers.description: Scales chemistry from a beaker to a plant that makes fuel, food or medicine.

careers.title: Environmental Engineer
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in environmental or civil engineering
careers.description: Designs the systems that clean water, cut emissions and handle waste.

careers.title: Land Surveyor
careers.education_note: Bachelor's plus licensure, or an associate plus apprenticeship
careers.description: Measures and marks property lines before anything gets built.

careers.title: Carpenter
careers.education_note: Apprenticeship, typically three to four paid years
careers.description: Frames houses and builds the things everyone else finishes.

careers.title: Heavy Equipment Operator
careers.education_note: Trade school or union apprenticeship plus a CDL
careers.description: Runs the excavators and cranes that move a job site.

careers.title: CNC Machinist
careers.education_note: Certificate or apprenticeship plus CNC programming
careers.description: Programs and runs machines that cut metal parts to a thousandth of an inch.

careers.title: Solar Panel Installer
careers.education_note: Short certificate plus on-the-job training
careers.description: Mounts and wires the panels going up on roofs everywhere.

careers.title: Elevator Installer / Repairer
careers.education_note: Four-year paid apprenticeship
careers.description: Installs and maintains elevators and escalators - one of the best-paid trades.

careers.title: Marine Service Technician
careers.education_note: Manufacturer training or a marine tech certificate
careers.description: Diagnoses and repairs boat engines and onboard systems.

careers.title: Railroad Conductor
careers.education_note: Company training program plus federal certification
careers.description: Runs the crew and the paperwork that keeps a freight train moving.

careers.title: Logistics Coordinator
careers.education_note: Associate degree, or experience plus certification
careers.description: Routes freight and fixes it when a shipment goes sideways.

careers.title: Insurance Underwriter
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in business, finance or economics
careers.description: Decides what a policy should cost by reading risk in the numbers.

careers.title: Actuary
careers.education_note: Bachelor's plus a long series of professional exams
careers.description: Prices risk for insurers using statistics - famously good pay, famously hard exams.

careers.title: Financial Advisor
careers.education_note: Bachelor's plus licensing; CFP to advance
careers.description: Helps families plan retirement, college and everything in between.

careers.title: Bank Branch Manager
careers.education_note: Bachelor's plus several years in retail banking
careers.description: Runs a branch: the team, the targets and the customers.

careers.title: Management Consultant
careers.education_note: Bachelor's to start; MBA to advance quickly
careers.description: Parachutes into companies to fix strategy, cost or operations.

careers.title: Product Manager
careers.education_note: Bachelor's plus experience in tech, design or analytics
careers.description: Decides what a software team builds next, and why.

careers.title: Event Planner
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in hospitality or communications
careers.description: Runs weddings and conferences down to the minute.

careers.title: Fashion Designer
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in fashion design plus a portfolio
careers.description: Designs garments from first sketch to production sample.

careers.title: Industrial Designer
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in industrial or product design
careers.description: Designs the physical products people pick up - tools, furniture, devices.

careers.title: Audio Engineer
careers.education_note: Certificate or associate plus a portfolio of work
careers.description: Records and mixes sound for music, film and live shows.

careers.title: Broadcast Technician
careers.education_note: Associate degree in broadcast technology
careers.description: Keeps the cameras, audio and transmitters running on air.

careers.title: Public Relations Specialist
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in PR, communications or journalism
careers.description: Shapes what the public and press hear about an organisation.

careers.title: Translator / Interpreter
careers.education_note: Bachelor's plus fluency and certification
careers.description: Moves meaning between languages in courtrooms, hospitals and business.

careers.title: Special Education Teacher
careers.education_note: Bachelor's plus a special education licence
careers.description: Adapts teaching so students with disabilities can actually learn.

careers.title: College Professor
careers.education_note: PhD in the field, plus research and teaching experience
careers.description: Teaches and researches at a college or university.

careers.title: Corporate Trainer
careers.education_note: Bachelor's plus experience in the subject taught
careers.description: Teaches working adults the skills their employer needs next.

careers.title: Probation Officer
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in criminal justice or social work
careers.description: Supervises people serving sentences in the community and tries to keep them out of prison.

careers.title: 911 Dispatcher
careers.education_note: Diploma plus agency training and certification
careers.description: Takes the emergency call and sends the right help, fast.

careers.title: Military Officer
careers.education_note: Bachelor's plus a commissioning programme
careers.description: Leads service members and is responsible for their training and safety.

careers.title: Park Ranger
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in natural resources or criminal justice
careers.description: Protects a park and the people in it - part naturalist, part law enforcement.

careers.title: Forester
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in forestry or natural resource management
careers.description: Manages forest land for timber, fire risk and habitat.

careers.title: Geologist
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in geology; master's for many roles
careers.description: Reads rock and soil for energy, water and hazard work.

careers.title: Biotechnology Lab Technician
careers.education_note: Associate or bachelor's in biotech or biology
careers.description: Runs the bench work behind drug and diagnostics research.

careers.title: Baker / Pastry Chef
careers.education_note: Culinary certificate or apprenticeship
careers.description: Runs the early shift turning out bread and pastry.

careers.title: Food Service Manager
careers.education_note: Associate degree or experience plus certification
careers.description: Runs a restaurant or cafeteria - staff, cost, safety and service.

careers.title: Massage Therapist
careers.education_note: 500-750 hour programme plus state licensure
careers.description: Treats pain and tension hands-on, often self-employed.

careers.title: Funeral Director
careers.education_note: Associate in mortuary science plus licensure
careers.description: Guides families through the arrangements after a death.

careers.title: Childcare Center Director
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in early childhood education plus licensing
careers.description: Runs a preschool or daycare - staff, curriculum and worried parents.

careers.title: Licensed Practical Nurse
careers.education_note: One-year LPN program plus the NCLEX-PN
careers.description: Gives bedside care under an RN in clinics and nursing homes.

careers.title: Nurse Anesthetist
careers.education_note: RN experience then a doctoral CRNA program
careers.description: Delivers anesthesia in surgery - the highest-paid nursing path.

careers.title: Nurse Midwife
careers.education_note: RN plus an accredited nurse-midwifery master's
careers.description: Delivers babies and cares for women before and after birth.

careers.title: Certified Nursing Assistant
careers.education_note: Four to twelve week state program plus certification
careers.description: Handles the hands-on daily care patients need most.

careers.title: Pediatrician
careers.education_note: MD/DO plus a three-year pediatrics residency
careers.description: Cares for children from newborn through the teen years.

careers.title: Surgeon
careers.education_note: MD/DO plus five to seven years of surgical residency
careers.description: Operates - long training, long hours, top of the pay scale.

careers.title: Anesthesiologist
careers.education_note: MD/DO plus a four-year anesthesiology residency
careers.description: Keeps patients safely unconscious and stable through surgery.

careers.title: Psychiatrist
careers.education_note: MD/DO plus a four-year psychiatry residency
careers.description: Diagnoses and treats mental illness, including medication.

careers.title: Dermatologist
careers.education_note: MD/DO plus a dermatology residency
careers.description: Treats skin conditions and screens for skin cancer.

careers.title: Emergency Physician
careers.education_note: MD/DO plus an emergency medicine residency
careers.description: Runs the ER - whatever comes through the door, in any order.

careers.title: Chiropractor
careers.education_note: Four-year Doctor of Chiropractic plus licensure
careers.description: Treats back, neck and joint pain with manual adjustment.

careers.title: Podiatrist
careers.education_note: Four-year DPM degree plus residency
careers.description: Treats foot and ankle problems, including surgery.

careers.title: Audiologist
careers.education_note: Doctor of Audiology plus state licensure
careers.description: Diagnoses hearing loss and fits hearing aids.

careers.title: Recreational Therapist
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in recreational therapy plus certification
careers.description: Uses activity and sport to rebuild function after illness or injury.

careers.title: Occupational Therapy Assistant
careers.education_note: Associate degree plus national certification
careers.description: Runs the therapy plan day to day with patients.

careers.title: Physical Therapy Assistant
careers.education_note: Associate degree plus state licensure
careers.description: Guides patients through the exercises that get them moving again.

careers.title: Pharmacy Technician
careers.education_note: Certificate plus state registration
careers.description: Fills prescriptions and keeps the pharmacy stocked and accurate.

careers.title: Histotechnologist
careers.education_note: Bachelor's plus ASCP certification
careers.description: Prepares tissue samples that pathologists read for cancer.

careers.title: Cytotechnologist
careers.education_note: Bachelor's in cytotechnology plus certification
careers.description: Screens cell samples under a microscope to catch disease early.

careers.title: Nuclear Medicine Technologist
careers.education_note: Associate degree plus NMTCB certification
careers.description: Uses radioactive tracers to image how organs are working.

careers.title: Radiation Therapist
careers.education_note: Associate or bachelor's plus ARRT certification
careers.description: Delivers radiation treatment to cancer patients.

careers.title: Dialysis Technician
careers.education_note: Certificate plus state or national certification
careers.description: Runs the machines that filter blood for kidney patients.

careers.title: Sterile Processing Technician
careers.education_note: Short certificate plus certification
careers.description: Cleans and sterilises every instrument the OR uses.

careers.title: Genetic Counselor
careers.education_note: Master's in genetic counseling plus board certification
careers.description: Explains genetic test results and what they mean for a family.
